description: Land Acquisition - Hodiwewa, Kuliyapitiya-East D/S Division, Kurunegala District and an Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2054/14 of 15.01.2018
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a ministerial order directing the taking of possession of a specific land parcel, including detailed description of the land's location, boundaries, and extent. The content focuses entirely on land matters without involving government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
